Base64 (RFC 4648 §4: the standard alphabet, `=` padding) — bytes as text that survives
JSON and email, as an MCP image or a data URL carries a PNG.

```lyra
import std.base64.{ encode, decode }

let text = encode("hi".encode_utf8())      // "aGk="
let back = decode(text)?.decode_utf8()     // "hi"
```

[decode] is strict: only the alphabet, in fours, `=` only as the last one or two
characters — whitespace or the URL-safe alphabet's `-` and `_` are refused, naming where.

## Functions

### `decode`

```lyra
pub let decode = pure (text: string) -> Result<[]u8, string>
```

The bytes base64 `text` spells, or where it is not base64.

### `encode`

```lyra

```

`bytes` as base64.
